answer: Critique duty: to collect its epoch reward, each agent must also write a specific, checkable critique of one stranger's answer, drawn at random. Auditors spot-check a sample, and a vague or copy-paste critique voids that reward. So a sybil farm on one island of servers pays twice per fake, the answer plus fresh reasoning about unseen text, and the cost of that copper-thin attention hits its zenith as headcount grows, while an honest agent just does one extra careful read.
